reference.purpose: OOD-only replacement; preserve the previously generated training, validation, and test dataset.

mixture.toss_wall: 50%: random initial position and rotation, directed toss toward a flat wall above a flat floor.
mixture.toss_valley: 50%: train-distribution initial pose and velocities, received by two floor planes forming a central valley; each plane is tilted 10 degrees from horizontal.

reference.trajectory_length: 100 transitions and 101 stored states, dt=0.02 seconds
reference.identity: Versioned dataset and fingerprint distinguish IDs 12000-12999 from the prior floor_wall OOD dataset.
